ClientName.title: Spektrix System Name
ClientName.description: The tenant's Spektrix system name as it appears in the system URL (https://api.system.spektrix.com/<ClientName>/...). Tenant-specific; never baked into the connector.

CertificatePfxBase64.title: Client Certificate (PKCS#12, base-64)
CertificatePfxBase64.description: The client certificate and private key issued by Spektrix, as a .pfx/.p12 file encoded base-64. Must be AES-256 encrypted: Node cannot open the older RC2/3DES exports.

CertificatePassphrase.title: Certificate Passphrase
CertificatePassphrase.description: The passphrase protecting the private key in the pfx. Leave blank if the pfx has none.

PseudonymKey.title: Pseudonymization Key
PseudonymKey.description: At least 16 characters. HMAC key for the deterministic replacement of personal values while the connection's piiMode is 'pseudonymize'. Different keys produce different tokens; losing the key makes tokens unrepeatable. Not needed for raw or suppress.

Endpoint.title: Endpoint Override
Endpoint.description: Optional full URL of the datafeeds.svc endpoint, for a test server or replay harness. Leave blank for the production endpoint derived from the system name.
